title: A Space website shows its admin links only to its admins, its membership button jumps to the membership section, and the editor exits to the website

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-16 on thegroupsd.com: the public site shows the admin edit button and footer admin bar to everyone; the membership button should jump to the membership section; admin links role based and a different colour; products linked to the marketplace; exiting the editor should return to the website.

detail: The website is cached and anonymous, so the header's Website builder chip and the footer admin section are now client islands (site-admin-gate.tsx) that ask the site's check after load and draw nothing until it confirms the reader runs the Space: /admin/session on the site's own host (the admin pass cookie, siteAdminAllowed) or /api/sites/<slug>/admin-session on Frequency's host (getSpaceCapabilities canEditProfile). The footer admin section has its own colour in the house and Network themes. The default Become a member button, or a Join / Memberships button, lands on Home's membership section when Home has one (siteMembershipAnchor). The editor's back control opens the live website page instead of the Space. The Group's merch cards point at their Market listings by a data paste.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(f)=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const bad=[];if(!/useSiteAdmin\(adminCheck\)/.test(r('components/sites/house-header.tsx')))bad.push('header admin links show to everyone');if(!r('components/sites/site-admin-bar.tsx').includes('<SiteAdminOnly'))bad.push('footer admin links show to everyone');if(!/'enter', 'session'/.test(r('lib/sites/host.ts')))bad.push('no site admin check route');if(!fs.existsSync('app/hosted/[host]/admin/session/route.ts'))bad.push('no hosted admin check');if(!r('components/sites/site-page.tsx').includes('siteMembershipAnchor('))bad.push('membership button misses the section');if(!r('components/sites/network-css.ts').includes('.hs-admin-tag'))bad.push('Network footer admin unstyled');if(r('components/sites/editor/shell.tsx').includes('Back to Space home'))bad.push('editor exits to the Space');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-970: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
